premise: Duckling starts a follow-the-leader game: Fox and Beaver copy everything he does — waddle, quack, head under a wing — then Beaver leads (gnaw a stick!), and when slow Snail arrives last, Duckling makes him the leader of the slowest parade the meadow has ever seen.
inspiration: The Pied Piper, turned gentle: a parade of friends copying the leader, and the leader hands the lead to the slowest one.
lesson: Everyone gets a turn to lead.

en-US.title: Follow the Duckling
en-US.text: [excited] Waddle, waddle, here came {duckling:enter} Duckling. {duckling:face happy} "Let's play follow the leader! Do what I do!" {fox:enter} Fox {fox:go to duckling} trotted in behind him. {beaver:enter} Beaver {beaver:go to fox} waddled in behind Fox. Duckling waddled. {fox:wobble} Fox waddled. {beaver:wobble} Beaver waddled. Duckling said {sfx:quack} "QUACK!" {fox:hop} Fox said "quack." {beaver:hop} Beaver said "quack." [giggles] Then Duckling {duckling:live nap hold} tucked his head under his wing. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} So Fox tucked his nose under his tail, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} and Beaver hid behind his stick. [whispers] Shhh… {duckling:live nap resume} Pop! Out came Duckling. {sfx:quack} "QUACK!" {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Everyone jumped. [laughs] "My turn!" said Beaver, and {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} he gnawed his stick. So Duckling nibbled a blade of grass. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} And Fox nibbled his own tail! Then, slowly, slowly, along crawled {snail:enter} Snail, last of all. {snail:face sad} "Can I play?" [happily] "You can LEAD!" said Duckling. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} So off went the parade behind Snail. Sloooowly. It took all afternoon, and nobody minded one bit.

es-ES.title: Todos detrás de Patito
es-ES.text: [excited] Bamboleándose, bamboleándose, llegó {duckling:enter} Patito. {duckling:face happy} —¡Vamos a jugar a imitar! ¡Haced todo lo que haga yo! {fox:enter} Zorro {fox:go to duckling} se puso detrás de él, al trote. {beaver:enter} Castor {beaver:go to fox} se colocó detrás de Zorro. Patito se bamboleó. {fox:wobble} Zorro se bamboleó. {beaver:wobble} Castor se bamboleó. Patito dijo {sfx:quack} «¡CUA!». {fox:hop} Zorro dijo «cua». {beaver:hop} Castor dijo «cua». [giggles] Entonces Patito {duckling:live nap hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. {fox:face sleeping} {fox:live tuck-tail hold} Zorro metió el hocico bajo la cola, {beaver:live hide-behind-stick} y Castor se escondió detrás de su palo. [whispers] Chsss… {duckling:live nap resume} ¡Plop! Asomó Patito. {sfx:quack} —¡CUA! {fox:live tuck-tail resume} {fox:face surprised} {beaver:face surprised} Todos dieron un bote. [laughs] —¡Ahora me toca a mí! —dijo Castor, y {beaver:live gnaw} {sfx:gnaw} royó su palo. Así que Patito mordisqueó una brizna de hierba. {fox:face happy} {fox:live chase-tail} ¡Y Zorro se mordisqueó la cola! Entonces, despacito, despacito, llegó {snail:enter} Caracol, el último de todos. {snail:face sad} —¿Puedo jugar? [happily] —¡Tú vas el primero! —dijo Patito. {snail:face happy} {duckling:go to snail} {fox:go to snail} {beaver:go to snail} Y allá fue el desfile detrás de Caracol. Despaaacito. Tardaron toda la tarde, y a nadie le importó ni pizca.

quack.prompt: a single cheerful duckling quack, realistic

gnaw.prompt: a small beaver gnawing wood quickly, little crunchy nibbles and chips, realistic
